# VidNest

> VidNest is a quiet, ad-free media extraction and playback ecosystem designed by Atheerium (https://atheerium.com). It enables users to download and organize public media from 1,800+ supported video and audio platforms across web, mobile Expo, and Telegram bot clients.

## Overview & Philosophy
- **Creator / Organization**: Atheerium (https://atheerium.com)
- **Design Philosophy**: Violet Instrument v4 aesthetic, calm typography, distraction-free utility.
- **Zero-Ad Policy**: No advertisements, no trackers, no surveillance cookies, no third-party telemetry scripts.
- **Zero-Emoji UI**: Purpose-built minimal geometric SVG iconography.
- **Bilingual Core**: Native Arabic-first (RTL) and English (LTR) interface and typography with self-hosted IBM Plex Sans Arabic.

## Architecture & Ecosystem
VidNest operates across three complementary form factors:

### 1. Web Application (`web/`)
- Universal media inspection and on-demand stream extraction ("Violet Instrument v4").
- Single-page interface built with vanilla semantic HTML5, pure CSS3 (custom properties, responsive grid/flexbox), and vanilla ES2022 JavaScript.
- Backend powered by Flask, NetGuard SSRF filter, and yt-dlp + FFmpeg.
- Secure CSRF protection (`X-VidNest-CSRF`), rate-limiting, and ephemeral storage cleanup.
- Self-hosted fonts (`IBM Plex Sans Arabic`, OFL license).
- Zero external CDNs, strict Content Security Policy (`font-src 'self'`).

### 2. Cross-Platform Mobile & Web App (`mobile-expo/`)
- Universal application built with React Native + Expo SDK 54 and TypeScript.
- Violet Instrument v4 dark/light theme designed with Astryx Design and StyleX design tokens (`src/theme/tokens.ts`).
- Centered Download Instrument (`App.tsx`, `CenteredDownloadInstrument.tsx`) supporting video/audio downloads, format inspection, and platform auto-detection.
- Native device integration: local caching, share sheet invocation, and offline recent downloads management.
- Full RTL Arabic interface, WCAG AA compliance, and accessible touch targets (>= 48dp).

### 3. Telegram Bot Companion (`web/bot.py`)
- Direct chat-based download assistant supporting single-file links and video extraction.
- Asynchronous polling or webhook delivery mode with secret token verification (`X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token`).
- Smart format selection with automated size compression fallback for Telegram's 50MB bot upload ceiling.

## Supported Platforms (1,800+)
VidNest extracts video and audio streams from over 1,800 global web services, including:
- **YouTube** (Shorts, standard videos, high-bitrate audio, up to 4K/60fps)
- **TikTok** (Watermark-free video and original sound)
- **Instagram** (Reels, stories, video posts)
- **X / Twitter** (Native video and audio spaces)
- **Facebook** (Reels, public watch videos, stories)
- **Vimeo** (HD/4K high-quality video streams)
- **Dailymotion** (Standard and high-definition video)
- **SoundCloud** (Original audio tracks, high-bitrate MP3/AAC)
- **Twitch** (Clips and VOD streams)
- **Reddit** (Reddit hosted videos with merged audio)
- **Pinterest** (Video pins)
- **Bilibili** (High-quality video and audio)
- **VK** (Video clips and posts)
- **1,800+ Additional Platforms** via the yt-dlp extraction engine

## Web API Endpoints

### Format Probe
- **Method**: `POST /api/formats`
- **Headers**:
  - `Content-Type: application/json`
  - `X-VidNest-CSRF: <csrf_token>`
- **Body**: `{"url": "https://..."}`
- **Response**:
  ```json
  {
    "probeId": "string",
    "title": "string",
    "uploader": "string",
    "extractor": "string",
    "duration": 185,
    "formats": [
      {
        "id": "137",
        "ext": "mp4",
        "quality": "1080p",
        "width": 1920,
        "height": 1080,
        "filesize": 25400000,
        "hasAudio": false,
        "hasVideo": true,
        "format": "1080p - 25MB"
      }
    ]
  }
  ```

### Media Download
- **Method**: `POST /api/download`
- **Headers**:
  - `Content-Type: application/json`
  - `X-VidNest-CSRF: <csrf_token>`
- **Body**: `{"url": "https://...", "probeId": "string", "formatId": "string"}`
- **Response**: `{"title": "string", "file": "<uuid>.<ext>"}`

### Quick Download
- **Method**: `POST /api/quick-download`
- **Headers**:
  - `Content-Type: application/json`
  - `X-VidNest-CSRF: <csrf_token>`
- **Body**: `{"url": "https://...", "mode": "video|audio|1080|720|480|360"}`
- **Response**: `{"title": "string", "file": "<uuid>.<ext>", "mode": "video", "formatId": "137"}`

### File Retrieval
- **Method**: `GET /files/<uuid>.<ext>`
- **Response**: Binary media stream (`Content-Disposition: attachment`).

### Health Check
- **Method**: `GET /healthz`
- **Response**: `{"ok": true, "service": "vidnest-web"}`

## Security Model & Safeguards
- **NetGuard SSRF Gate**: Blocks loopback, RFC1918 private subnets, link-local, carrier-grade NAT, multicast, and cloud metadata IP addresses (e.g., 169.254.169.254).
- **Anti-CSRF**: Mandatory cryptographically random CSRF tokens for all state-changing endpoints.
- **Strict Host & Origin Validation**: Prevents DNS rebinding and cross-site scripting/POST abuse.
- **Content Security Policy (CSP)**: Disallows unauthorized inline scripts, object-src, and frame embedding (`frame-ancestors: 'none'`). Self-hosted fonts only (`font-src 'self'`).
- **Safe Output Storage**: Downloads are saved to randomized UUID filenames; path traversal attempts are strictly rejected.
- **Ephemeral Storage**: Background and startup routines sweep completed files after expiration to prevent disk exhaustion.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Is VidNest free and ad-free?
Yes. VidNest is open-source, completely free, and contains zero advertisements, trackers, or commercial monetization scripts.

### Can VidNest download videos in 4K resolution?
Yes. For sources that provide 4K (2160p) streams, VidNest automatically pairs high-resolution video with the highest-bitrate audio stream using server-side FFmpeg multiplexing.

### How are user files handled?
VidNest does not log personal activity or build viewing profiles. On the web client, media files are stored temporarily in a private temporary directory and deleted automatically after expiration. On the mobile Expo app, files are saved directly to local device cache and shared via the native system share sheet.
